key.name: max-history
key.summary: Maximum number of history items

key.name: reorder-after-paste
key.summary: Move items to the top when they are copied again
key.description: When off, history is ordered by when an item was first copied.

key.name: allow-duplicate
key.summary: Record content that is already in history

key.name: overwrite-duplicate
key.summary: Replace the existing entry instead of adding a second one

key.name: record-images
key.summary: Record copied images
key.description: Images are kept as PNG files in ~/.local/share/gclippy/images. Text is recorded instead when a copy offers both.

key.name: ignore-concealed
key.summary: Ignore content that password managers mark as secret
key.description: Skips clipboard content offering the x-kde-passwordManagerHint type.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: Applications whose copies are not recorded
key.description: WM_CLASS names or application ids (e.g. "KeePassXC" or "org.keepassxc.KeePassXC").

key.name: confirm-clear-history
key.summary: Ask before clearing history

key.name: clear-periodically
key.summary: Clear history periodically

key.name: clear-interval
key.summary: Seconds between periodic history clears

key.name: clear-on-disable
key.summary: Clear history when the extension is disabled
key.description: GNOME also disables extensions while the screen is locked, so this clears history on lock as well.

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show the icon in the top bar

key.name: show-icons
key.summary: Show icons next to folders and snippets

key.name: snippets-above-history
key.summary: Show snippets above history in the main menu

key.name: inline-limit
key.summary: History items shown directly in the menu

key.name: folder-limit
key.summary: History items per numbered submenu

key.name: max-title-length
key.summary: Maximum menu item title length

key.name: mark-numbers
key.summary: Number menu items

key.name: start-at-zero
key.summary: Start numbering at 0

key.name: show-clear-history-item
key.summary: Show "Clear History" in the main menu

key.name: show-images
key.summary: Show image thumbnails in the menu

key.name: thumbnail-width
key.summary: Maximum thumbnail width

key.name: thumbnail-height
key.summary: Maximum thumbnail height

key.name: show-tooltips
key.summary: Show a preview of the highlighted item

key.name: max-preview-lines
key.summary: Maximum number of lines in the preview
key.description: Longer texts end with "…". Each line is also cut after 300 characters.

key.name: paste-automatically
key.summary: Paste the selected item into the focused window

key.name: number-keys
key.summary: Paste history items by pressing their number
key.description: While a gclippy menu is open, 1-9 paste items 1-9 and 0 pastes item 10 (0-9 when numbering starts at 0).

key.name: delete-modifier
key.summary: Modifier that deletes the selected history item instead of pasting it

key.name: paste-delete-modifier
key.summary: Modifier that pastes the selected history item and then deletes it

key.name: terminal-wm-classes
key.summary: Windows that paste with Ctrl+Shift+V
key.description: WM_CLASS names or application ids, matched like excluded-apps.

key.name: shortcut-main
key.summary: Open the main menu

key.name: shortcut-history
key.summary: Open the history menu

key.name: shortcut-snippets
key.summary: Open the snippets menu

key.name: shortcut-settings
key.summary: Open settings
